OAT-06/S15.title: General feedback from Settings in both contexts: stored with rating and comment flag, apart from the other surveys
OAT-06/S15.detail: Local QA stack only (main e02167f), a brand-new @roundai.test physician per test, synthetic charts deleted after the reads. No model: every ai/* action is refused at the Convex socket and none was sent; tripwire clean for the final run (16:43:28Z mark, 'no model call'). Rows are read with the local admin key (patientActivity / usage / surveys _recentForActor, usage:_dailyForActor) before and after the steps; reading them through Vikram's dashboard on the UAT deployment is S23 / Q12. Settings from the Hospital list's bottom nav: Rate 2 + 'QA OAT-06 feedback: dictation is slow on hospital Wi-Fi.' -> Send feedback; closed Settings, switched to Nursing Home, Settings from that list (it showed 'Nursing Home Note Templates'), Rate 5, no comment -> Send feedback. Judged 6/6: both checkpoints and 'Thanks - your feedback was sent.' after each send; exactly two surveyResponses rows since T0, survey 'feedback': {rating 2, comment = the typed text} and {rating 5} with no comment key; no baseline and no handoff_followup row (the baseline card was left untouched). Record-only: both rows carry day 2026-10-15 and only rating / comment keys; a feedback row does not say which care setting it came from (not asked by OAT-06 or AC 5). The once-daily 4-5 PM card and the survey copy belong to TFA-94609 (ready for pr): not part of this case (S14 / S27).
